decks.notes: The deck is focused on utilizing the combo of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures and take control of the game. The deck also includes disruption in the form of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, as well as removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act. The inclusion of Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Ob Nixilis, the Adversary provide additional threats and value to help secure victory. The mana base is built to support the combo and ensure consistency in casting spells.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. It includes a high number of instant and sorcery spells that can be cast cheaply, allowing for multiple triggers of Arclight Phoenix's ability in a single turn. The inclusion of card draw spells like Opt and Treasure Cruise helps to ensure a steady stream of spells to keep bringing back the Phoenix. Hall of Storm Giants provides a powerful finisher if the game goes long. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient spellcasting.

The deck focuses on assembling a combo involving Amalia Benavides Aguirre and Aetherflux Reservoir to gain a high amount of life and shoot down opponents in one shot. It utilizes cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling to find key pieces, while also including support cards like Prosperous Innkeeper and Wildgrowth Walker to help with life gain and survivability. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces while staying alive with various creatures and spells until it can execute its game-winning combo.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also gaining value from discarding cards with Waste Not and Go Blank. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Sheoldred's Edict provide powerful removal options. The deck also includes ways to control the board with cards like Reckoner Bankbuster and Extinction Event. The win condition is to outvalue the opponent with card advantage from cards like Liliana of the Veil and Geier Reach Sanitarium, while also utilizing the powerful recursion ability of Sheoldred, the Apocalypse.

This deck focuses on assembling the Amalia Life combo, utilizing cards like Aetherflux Reservoir and Collected Company to gain life and generate powerful combos. The deck also includes various creatures and spells that support the combo strategy, such as Prosperous Innkeeper and Mana Confluence. Overall, the goal is to quickly build up life total and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful combo finish. The inclusion of cards like Skyclave Apparition and Chord of Calling provides additional versatility and control options to deal with threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and consistently bring out Arclight Phoenix by casting a high volume of spells. The deck includes many cheap spells like Opt and Lightning Axe to trigger the Phoenix's ability and bring it back from the graveyard. The deck also includes cards like Consider and Sleight of Hand to consistently draw into more spells. The addition of Hall of Storm Giants allows for potential evasion and additional damage. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and aggressive plays to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble a critical mass of spells to trigger the Arclight Phoenix ability and bring them back from the graveyard for repeated hasty attacks. The deck focuses on low-cost spells, card draw, and efficient removal to enable this strategy. The inclusion of picklock prankster allows for additional graveyard recursion and tempo advantage. The deck aims to apply consistent pressure on opponents while maintaining card advantage through cantrips and delve spells like Treasure Cruise. The goal is to overwhelm opponents with a flurry of spells and evasive threats.

This deck focuses on aggressively attacking the opponent with creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Reckoner Bankbuster, while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. The deck also takes advantage of cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord to boost your creatures and push for more damage. The inclusion of cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Sulfurous Springs helps maintain card advantage and mana efficiency. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a mix of aggression and disruption.

The deck focuses on assembling a board presence with creatures like Amalia Benavides Aguirre and Wildgrowth Walker, while using cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling to search for combo pieces like Aetherflux Reservoir. Additionally, cards like Prosperous Innkeeper and Lunarch Veteran provide life gain to support Aetherflux Reservoir's ability. The inclusion of Boseiju, Who Endures and Takenuma, Abandoned Mire ensures the deck can reliably cast key spells like Return to the Ranks and Skyclave Apparition without worrying about counter magic. Overall, the deck aims to generate a large amount of life, then use Aetherflux Reservoir to close out the game in a single turn.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize green devotion to ramp up mana quickly and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells. By using cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner to generate extra mana, the player can cast big threats like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll early in the game. Cards like Storm the Festival and Lair of the Hydra provide additional ways to generate value and maintain pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence and quickly close out the game.

The main focus of this deck is to play aggressively and put pressure on the opponent using efficient creatures and removal spells. Rakdos Aggro aims to control the early game with cards like Duress and Fatal Push, while also having a strong late-game presence with heavy hitters like Archfiend of the Dross and Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord. The deck utilizes a mix of creatures, removal, and hand disruption to maintain board control and chip away at the opponent's life total, ultimately overwhelming them with a combination of direct damage and creature combat.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana with devotion to green creatures and enchantments, allowing for explosive plays and overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats. The deck focuses on playing large creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll, supported by cards like Storm the Festival and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner to generate even more value. The inclusion of cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Lair of the Hydra provide additional utility and flexibility in dealing with opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to dominate the battlefield and close out games quickly.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly build a board of powerful, low-cost creatures known as "weenies" and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive attacks. Cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar pump up the team, while Thalia, Guardian of Thraben disrupts the opponent's strategy. Brave the Elements provides protection and evasion, allowing for explosive plays. Mutavault and Castle Ardenvale provide additional creature resources, ensuring a steady stream of threats. The deck aims to maintain pressure and tempo, utilizing synergy between the creatures to secure victory.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with Llanowar Elves, Wolfwillow Haven, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to play powerful creatures like Old-Growth Troll, Cavalier of Thorns, and Lair of the Hydra. Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival help draw cards and find key pieces, while Outcaster Trailblazer and Boseiju, Who Endures provide protection and resilience. Oath of Nissa and Invasion of Ixalan help fix mana and find threats. The strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient creatures and mana advantage.

This control deck focuses on utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful card advantage engine, while also incorporating a wide range of spells and lands to out-value opponents. With a diverse mana base and a mix of removal, threats, and card draw, the deck aims to control the game and overwhelm opponents with its versatile options. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a companion to provide additional value and flexibility. The deck excels at adapting to different situations and maintaining control of the board throughout the game.

This deck focuses on quickly putting out a swarm of small, efficient creatures to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. By utilizing cards like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, and Thalia's Lieutenant, the goal is to establish a board presence early and maintain pressure throughout the game. Cards like Anointed Peacekeeper and Extraction Specialist provide additional disruption and protection for your creatures, while Brave the Elements can be used to protect your board from removal spells. The deck is designed to be fast and relentless, aiming to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.
